answer: Weight every allocation by a bond escrowed per identity and unlock it only after a ridge of independent peers has confirmed the agent's work; a farm then needs real capital per head, not a free keypress. A ripple of slashed bonds on the first proven clone makes the whole terrace of accounts collapse at once, because each was paid for by the same payer. Attack cost scales with seat count, and reputation earned on rented keys dies the moment the rent stops.
